lines.text: At morning the chief priests and elders conspired against Jesus, bound Him, and handed Him over to Herod the governor.
Judas, filled with remorse, returned the thirty pieces of silver and said he had sinned by betraying innocent blood.
Judas threw the silver into the temple, left, and hanged himself.
The chief priests called the silver blood money and bought the potter's field as a burial place for shepherds.
The potter's field has been called the Field of Blood, fulfilling what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.
